inlines.v: JOVE, noun [Latin Jovis.] 1. The name of the Supreme Deity among the Romans. 2. The planet jupiter. Or ask of yonder argent fields above. Why Jove's satellites are less than jove 3. The air or atmosphere, or the god of the air. And jove descends in showers of kindly rain.
